sql: SELECT T2.State, SUM(T1.t_fed_rev), SUM(T1.c14), SUM(T1.c25) FROM FINREV_FED_17 T1 JOIN FINREV_FED_KEY_17 T2 ON T1.state_code=T2.State_Code JOIN NDECoreExcel_Math_Grade8 T3 ON T2.State=T3.state GROUP BY T2.State ORDER BY T3.average_scale_score DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT T1.school_district, MAX(T1.c14), T3.average_scale_score FROM FINREV_FED_17 T1 JOIN FINREV_FED_KEY_17 T2 ON T1.state_code=T2.State_Code JOIN NDECoreExcel_Math_Grade8 T3 ON T2.State=T3.state UNION SELECT T1.school_district, MAX(T1.c25), T3.average_scale_score FROM FINREV_FED_17 T1 JOIN FINREV_FED_KEY_17 T2 ON T1.state_code=T2.State_Code JOIN NDECoreExcel_Math_Grade8 T3 ON T2.State=T3.state

SELECT T2.State, T3.average_scale_score FROM FINREV_FED_17 T1 JOIN FINREV_FED_KEY_17 T2 ON T1.state_code=T2.State_Code JOIN NDECoreExcel_Math_Grade8 T3 ON T2.State=T3.state GROUP BY T2.State ORDER BY SUM(T1.t_fed_rev) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T2.State, T3.average_scale_score FROM FINREV_FED_17 T1 JOIN FINREV_FED_KEY_17 T2 ON T1.state_code=T2.State_Code JOIN NDECoreExcel_Math_Grade8 T3 ON T2.State=T3.state GROUP BY T2.State ORDER BY SUM(T1.t_fed_rev) ASC LIMIT 1
